g.text: Which syndrome features matter for epicenter localization?

g.text: Feature ablation on the primary SVR corpus (d5, 4.096 ms, fixed model and split)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #9a542a

g.text: Lower mean localization error is better. Only the five poster-relevant controls are shown.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #18324b

g.text: Interpretation: removing spatial check information (F2) causes a large error increase; shuffling check positions (N1) has a similar effect.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d6072

g.text: F0 = spatial + temporal | F1 = spatial only | F2 = no spatial / temporal only | N1 = shuffled check positions | N2 = shuffled time order

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d6072

g.text: All variants use the same 120-dimensional input size and fixed SVR hyperparameters; no test-set feature selection was performed.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #7d8b98
